name: now-playing-claude-bridge
description: Lets Claude report task progress and ask-for-input alerts to the Now Playing pop-up on your desktop.
long_description: Adds three small tools. Claude calls them to update a progress bar for the task it is working on, to send you a desktop notification when it needs your answer, and to mark the task finished. Everything stays on your PC: the tools only talk to the Now Playing app on 127.0.0.1.

tools.name: progress_update
tools.description: Update the progress bar for the task you are working on.

tools.name: ask_user_alert
tools.description: Notify the user that you need their answer or a decision.

port.title: Now Playing port
port.description: Local port of the Now Playing app (leave as 47823 unless you changed it there).
